name: jhh3-mem
description: Local-only episodic session memory: one SQLite file with FTS5, two additive hooks, no daemon, no network, one-command removal. the owner's machines only.

interface.shortDescription: Cross-session episodic memory, shared between Claude Code and Codex.
interface.longDescription: Writes one deterministic record per session to a local SQLite store, injects a bounded repo-scoped digest at session start, and exposes an explicit search path. No daemon, no listening socket, no network call. Sessions from Claude Code and Codex share a single store.
